question: Operation by operation, what the middle of 009F3F80 does with blk+1D0h and blk+1D4h before the hop: the heading-error path into 009DA250, what fills the obstacle tables, how an obstacle reverses or reduces the throttle, and the throttle ceiling.
answer: The middle is 009F40CA..009F4B98 and it is one routine in six parts. It turns the state's desired pair into a throttle out of 009EC7C0's five AutoThrust stages, limited by blk+344h and snapped by the 65-bin cost profile at blk+4h (009D6B40); a rudder out of 009DA250 on the goal heading error blk+324h, limited by blk+348h; and then, when the obstacle sector the rudder points into is blocked, a rudder out of 009DA250 on that sector's avoidance bearing instead, plus either a reversed throttle band or the one-second astern latch blk+380h, which forces the profile window to [-1, 0]. blk+344h and blk+348h are what 009F4DA0 writes into brain+34Ch and brain+350h one step earlier; the sectors are filled by 009EB660 through 009EF230, the chain slot at 009F51FA.

corrections.was: docs/SHIP_AI_THROTTLE_TO_RING.md uncertainty 3: 'the two 2Ch-stride tables at blk+81Ch and blk+848h, indexed by ((direction * 6) + bucket) * 2Ch'
corrections.is: One array of twelve 2Ch-byte sectors based at blk+808h. blk+81Ch is sector[i]+14h and blk+848h is sector[i+1]+14h, the same byte of the next sector, which is why 009F4632..009F464E can nudge the index by one.
corrections.evidence: 009F45B3 CMP byte ptr [EAX+ESI+81Ch],0 and 009F45C0 CMP byte ptr [EDI+848h],0 with EDI = EAX+ESI; 009F4653/009F4662/009F4669 read +828h/+82Ch/+830h of the same index; 009EF230 at 009EF30E computes (index)*2Ch + 808h and writes +8h of that; 009EB660 clears this+14h and this+24h of the same record

corrections.was: docs/SHIP_AI_THROTTLE_TO_RING.md follow-up ship_ai_throttle_ceiling: 'what 009F4DA0 computes into brain+34Ch / +350h'
corrections.is: brain+34Ch is blk+344h and brain+350h is blk+348h, because 009F4DA0's this is the brain and blk = brain+8h. blk+344h is the throttle magnitude limit the middle of 009F3F80 applies at 009F4441..009F4482 and the cap it hands 009EC7C0 at 009F4406; blk+348h is the rudder magnitude limit applied at 009F4525..009F4544. 009F4DA0 sets blk+348h to 1.0f unconditionally at 009F4DBC before anything else.
corrections.evidence: 009F4DAD MOV ESI,ECX and 009F50C0 LEA ECX,[ESI+8]; 009F4DB6 LEA EBP,[ESI+350h]; 009F4DBC MOVSS [EBP],XMM0 with XMM0 = 1.0f from 00D7A24C; the decompiled 009F4DA0 tests param_1+364h against 1 and writes param_1+374h, which are blk+35Ch (an int latch 0/1/2) and blk+36Ch (a byte)

corrections.was: include/bsp/ship_ai_states.hpp ShipAiControlBlock: 'bool yaw_rate_subtracts_364; // +364h, picks add or subtract'
corrections.is: Refined, not contradicted: blk+364h is the committed ahead/astern direction. Clear means astern and set means ahead. The comment describes how 009ED6B0 uses the same bit.
corrections.evidence: 009EC9CD CMP byte ptr [EDI+364h],0 then FCHS and the -0.625 floor, so a clear byte negates the whole throttle ceiling; 009F4441 caps the throttle at +blk+344h when set and floors it at -blk+344h when clear; 009F44C3 picks sector group 1 (the astern group) when it is clear and the hull is stopped; 009F4B0F and 009F4B74 flip it, each after zeroing the throttle on the side it is abandoning

uncertainties: blk+37Ch, the clearance the danger ramp divides by unit+9CCh, is written only inside 009EF910 (six sites), which 009F4D10 calls. That routine was not read.
blk+33Ch, the gate on the rudder limit, is published by 009F4D10 at 009F4D2B and read at 009F4514; its producer was not read.
blk+368h, the escape dwell timer 009F3F80 sets to 1.0f, is counted down elsewhere. ship_ai_states.hpp attributes the countdown to 009ED6B0; that was not re-checked here.

The sign convention of 009D8B90's result is read from the listing, not from a run: a positive result above 0.75 * blk+3C4h arms the astern latch, and which of approach or recession that is was not confirmed dynamically.

No run-time evidence. bsp_game.exe records 009F40CA..009F4B98 (docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2o) and never runs 009EF230, so the executable cannot reach the obstacle arms until this projection and the sector producer are both wired. src/ship_motion_probe.cpp is owned by another packet this turn and was not touched.
